CustomField.formula: IF( ISNULL(Student__r.Setup__r.Passing_Grade_Threshold__c) , Course_Credits__c, IF (Credit_Earned_Override__c , Course_Credits__c, IF (Final_Grade_Value__c >= Student__r.Setup__r.Passing_Grade_Threshold__c, Course_Credits__c, 0)))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This is the credits earned for a course. This field displays on transcripts.
CustomField.label: Credits Earned
